name: PVWF World Championship
epitaph: Held by Aaron Bolles across both surviving December 1997 shows; defends in a non-title match against Tonzee.

name: PVWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held by Billy Dahl across both surviving shows; the fed's own 29 December broadcast credits him as "the second two-time PVWF Intercontinental champion," implying an off-page title change and reclaim at the unheld X-Mas Explosion PPV.

name: PVWF Television Championship
epitaph: Held by Big Dave on 22 December; by 29 December the champion is Pearl, the title having changed at the unheld X-Mas Explosion PPV. Pearl's title defense against former champion Stephen McCoy ends without a finish, interrupted by a backstage angle.

name: PVWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Vacant as of 22 December, contested in a match that show; Slim & Elle win the vacant title at the unheld X-Mas Explosion PPV and defend twice on 29 December, both matches ending without a finish.

name: PVWF Women's Championship
epitaph: Referenced only as discontinued ("whatever happened to the PVWF Woman's title") on the 22 December show; no holder or discontinuation date survives.
